checks.plain_english_result: Two cloud contracts have stable IDs, owners, terms, and annual/actual values.
Twelve AP-reconciled monthly rows per contract.
Monthly service-level usage rows by provider, account, app, service, region, and tags.
Commitments include EDP/EA and reservation/Savings Plan records.
Resources carry utilization, rightsize signal, owner/app tags, and monthly spend.
Monthly tag coverage exposes accountable and blocked spend.
Cloud billing export and AP-paid amount reconcile at invoice month grain.
Actions remain candidate/control states. Finance confirmation is not asserted.
Every evidence file is marked synthetic demo evidence only.

guardrails: All money rows are synthetic demo evidence and must remain candidate/not_confirmed until finance confirmation changes.
Native cloud tools remain source systems; Nexus is the governed cross-system sourcing layer.
Cloud billing export is reconciled to AP before paid-spend claims.
Business-unit savings claims are blocked where owner/application tags are missing.
